Shortly after the establishment of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a '''battle''' took place in the [[Dalchon system/Legends|Dalchon system]] between the [[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class battlecruiser]] ''[[Battalion (Praetor-class)|Battalion]]'' and a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]].

==Battle==
Following the establishment of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] began to be disillusioned with the new government and the institution that had replaced the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. Specifically, he saw the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] new breed of [[Officer/Legends|officers]] caring more for power and glory for themselves, and not for the people they served. Civil liberties and voices were silenced as the Empire took control of the galaxy in an iron grip.<ref name="TM" />

Tallon decided to fake his [[Death/Legends|death]] and go into hiding, planning to re-emerge when the time was right to fight against the Empire. While touring the [[Dalchon system/Legends|Dalchon system]] in his<ref name="TM" /> [[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class battlecruiser]]<ref name="EGW" /> ''[[Battalion (Praetor-class)|Battalion]]'', Tallon came to the aid of a civil [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] under [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] attack. As part of his plan, the pirate [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was under the command of Tallon's friend, [[Quist (pirate)|Quist]].<ref name="TM" />

Officially, Tallon and his crew were lauded as heroes, lost in an attempt to save a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] vessel. In truth, Quist and his pirates covered for Tallon and his crew, transpoting them to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TM" />
